app.name: Progresso
app.tagline: Track every rep of the journey.

step1.title: Log
step1.body: Record your body measurements and a progress photo each week.

step2.title: Review
step2.body: Your trainer reviews your trends and compares your photos over time.

step3.title: Adjust
step3.body: You chat with your trainer and adjust your plan together.

home.empty: No measurements yet. Log your first entry to see your progress here.

height.title: Height
height.description: Set once — used to compute your BMI. It rarely changes, so you don't log it with every measurement.
height.label: Height

measurements.title: My measurements
measurements.empty: No entries yet. Tap “Log new” to add your first.

detail.confirmDelete: Delete this measurement? This cannot be undone.
detail.notFound: That measurement could not be found.

progress.title: My progress
progress.empty: No data yet. Log a few measurements to chart your trends.
progress.needMore: Log at least two entries to chart a trend.

goals.title: My goals
goals.empty: No goals yet. Add one above to set a target.

roster.title: My trainees
roster.empty: No trainees yet. They appear here once a client registers and selects you, or links you from their home.

addTrainee.title: Add a trainee
addTrainee.intro: Clients join by signing up themselves — no account creation needed.
addTrainee.step1: Share the signup link below with your client.
addTrainee.step2: They create an account and pick you as their trainer (or leave it blank and link you later).
addTrainee.step3: Once linked, they appear on your roster automatically.
addTrainee.yourName: Your name (so they can find you)

overview.notFound: That trainee could not be found.

chat.title: Chat
chat.noTrainer: Link a trainer to start chatting.

data.title: Your data
data.description: Download everything you've logged, or permanently delete your account.
data.deleteWarning: This permanently deletes your account and all your data. It cannot be undone.
